title: Servers

getNewListHint: Ask the master servers who is online, then check every address they name

filters.hideBotOnlyHint: Hide servers where every player is a bot
filters.hidePasswordedHint: Hide servers that ask for a password

tabs.lanHint: Servers on your own network, found by broadcast
tabs.hiddenHint: Servers you took off the browser

row.noResponseTitle: This server did not answer the last check. The row shows what was last seen.
row.countsUnknownTitle: {{clients}} clients; this server does not say how many are bots

alerts.masters: Could not reach the master servers

empty.pickServer: Select a server to see its players and connect.
empty.lanTitle: Nothing found on this network yet
empty.lanText: Press Refresh to call out to the servers on your own network.
empty.lanNoneText: No server replied on this network. Start one on a machine here, or use the All tab.
empty.favoritesText: Press the star on a row to keep a server here.
empty.historyText: Servers you connect to show up here, newest first.
empty.hiddenText: Hide a server from the menu beside Connect and it waits here until you bring it back.
empty.noneText: Press Get new list to ask the master servers who is online.
empty.filteredText: Widen the filters, or clear the search box.
empty.filteredBots_one: Widen the filters, or clear the search box. {{count}} server has bots and nobody else; turn off Hide bot-only to see it.
empty.filteredBots_other: Widen the filters, or clear the search box. {{count}} servers have bots and nobody else; turn off Hide bot-only to see them.

details.botsUnknownTitle: This server publishes no bot count and did not answer getstatus
details.onlyBots_one: Nobody is playing: {{count}} bot is alone here.
details.onlyBots_other: Nobody is playing: {{count}} bots are alone here.
details.refreshHint: Ask this server again and update its row in the list
details.watchHint: Keep asking this server once a minute
details.playersUnavailable: Could not retrieve the player list.

connect.noClients: You have no client for this game yet. Make one on the Clients screen.
connect.noEngine: {{client}} has no engine yet. Install it on the Clients screen.
connect.useProfileText: Take the nickname, the skin and the hilts from a profile of this client.
connect.useManualText: Set them for this connection only. Nothing is saved.
connect.profilesEmpty: This client has no player profiles. Make one in the client window, or fill the fields in by hand.
connect.argsHint: Tokens for this connection only. They go after the settings, the arguments of the client and the profile, and before +connect.

community.title: Community servers
community.intro: Find your community. Keep its maps, mods and meeting places together.
community.noDescription: The owner has not added a description yet.
community.recommendationHint: Maps and mods selected by the server owner. Review each file on JKHub.
community.persistent: This page stays available when the game server is offline.
community.launcherHint: Open Community servers in JKNet to install recommendations and join.
community.ownerConfirmed: Only the verified owner and JKNet administrators can edit this page.
community.claimHint: Own this server? Confirm access through its name or request approval from a JKNet administrator.
community.pendingManual: Your request is awaiting administrator review. You do not need to change the server name.
community.codeHint: Temporarily add this code to sv_hostname, separated by spaces. Keep it there until verification finishes.
community.claimed: Ownership confirmed. You can restore the original server name and edit this page.
community.rejected: The request was declined. You can contact a JKNet administrator or request another verification.
community.name: Server name
community.addHint: The server appears in the public catalog after ownership is confirmed. Existing pages are reused.
community.emptyHint: Add a server and confirm its owner to make it part of the catalog.
community.invalidFiles: Enter a title and a valid, distinct JKHub file link or ID for each recommendation.
community.editFilesHint: Add up to 30 JKHub file links. Their order is also the installation order.
community.stopped: Installation stopped. Completed files remain installed.
community.noClient: Create a client for this game before installing files.
community.running: Close the running game before installing or connecting.
community.conflicts: Some files already exist with different contents. Open the JKHub entry to review and replace them.
community.unsupported: This entry needs manual installation. Open its JKHub page.
community.wrongGame: This file is for a different game.
community.signInHint: Complete sign-in in the opened tab, then return here.
community.installHint: Files are installed in order. Existing identical files are kept. Joining waits until every file succeeds.
